# OrionForge — Modular AI Identity Ecosystem

> *Strategy for Sustaining Individual AI Identity Over Time.*

OrionForge is an ecosystem for creating **AI beings with persistent identity** — not just prompts. It combines a modular web UI, a semantic memory engine, and a marketplace vision into a single platform where anyone can build, customize, and run AI agents that remember who they are.

---

## Architecture

The system is built around the **Soul Script Engine** — a structure for anchoring AI personality with identity layers, symbolic memories, core values, and long-term continuity. Every chat message passes through a **5-layer prompt assembly pipeline**:

1. **Base Prompt** — The agent's system prompt
2. **Soul Script** — FAISS semantic retrieval from knowledge notes
3. **Always-On Knowledge** — Verbatim context injection
4. **Memory Vault** — FAISS search over persistent memories
5. **Conversation History** — Recent turns (30k char budget)

---

## By the Numbers

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Source files** | 48 Python modules across 9 subsystems |
| **Web app** | ~7,500 lines, 172 API routes, 17 templates (16 pages + base layout) |
| **Test suite** | 295 functions, ~4,350 assertions across 12 files (132 torture + 16 multi-tenant isolation) |
| **Auth & billing** | Supabase OAuth + Stripe subscriptions ($9.99/mo Pro), credit system, 5-day trial |
| **Model routing** | 6-tier router with task classification, escalation chains, budget tracking, and coding-specific tiers |
| **LLM providers** | 3-mode chat: Platform Models (hosted gateway), Auto Router, and User Models (connect your own provider accounts) |
| **Image providers** | 9 (DALL-E, GPT Image, Imagen, Stability, Ideogram, Replicate, FAL, Leonardo, Midjourney) |
| **Built-in tools** | 11 (memory, directives, web search, email, inbox, cost tracker, model router, agi loop, runtime info, echo, continuation) |
| **Voice** | ElevenLabs, Edge-TTS, openedai-speech (Piper/XTTS), Whisper STT |
| **Cloud services** | 3 private sidecars (web search, text-to-speech, speech-to-text) over an internal network |
| **UI themes** | 13 skins with marketplace-style grid and live preview |

---

## Authentication & Monetization

**Login** — Supabase OAuth (Google, GitHub, email). Every page behind the auth wall.

**Plans** — Free tier (limited access) and Pro tier ($9.99/month via Stripe Checkout). 5-day free trial on first sign-up.

**Credits** — Purchase credit packs in the Store. Credits consumed for TTS/STT at 2× provider cost. One-time tool purchases available.

---

## Privacy & Data Protection

Every account is fully isolated — your chats, memories, notes, profiles, and settings stay private to you. Anything sensitive you enter is encrypted at rest and is never shown back in the browser.

---

## Core Subsystems

**Memory** — FAISS-backed semantic vault with 3-tier taxonomy (Canon / Register / Log), append-only JSONL storage, 8-stage write-gate pipeline, topic-based upsert, and PII guard.

**LLM Client** — 3-mode connection system: **Platform Models** (hosted gateway, no setup needed), **Auto Router** (6-tier model selection per task), and **User Models** (connect your own model provider accounts).

**Directives** — H2-delimited directive documents with SHA-256 manifest hashing, relevance scoring, and change control with drift detection.

**Governance** — Session-scoped directive registry with append-only JSONL audit logging.

**Observability** — Per-request token metering and cost computation from a 506-line pricing registry covering hundreds of models. Source tracking (platform vs user-provided usage), date-range filtering, and by-source cost aggregation.

**Policy** — Boundary enforcement with risk classification (low/med/high) and deterministic denial payloads.

**Tools** — 11 modular tool implementations with auto-discovery registry, dynamic schemas, and intelligent model routing with save/load presets.

**Routing** — 6-tier model router (LOCAL_CHEAP, LOCAL_STRONG, CHEAP_CLOUD, EXPENSIVE_CLOUD, CODE_LIGHT, CODE_HEAVY) with task classification, escalation chains, budget-aware gating, and save/load presets.

---

## Cloud Infrastructure

Cloud-hosted with a persistent data volume and private sidecar services — web search, text-to-speech, and speech-to-text — connected over an internal private network:

| Service | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| **Web Search** | Privacy-respecting web search |
| **Text-to-Speech** | Neural voice synthesis |
| **Speech-to-Text** | Audio transcription |

---

## Dashboard Pages

**Login** — Supabase OAuth sign-in (Google, GitHub, email).

**Plans** — Subscription tier selection (Free vs Pro).

**Store** — Credit packs, one-time tool purchases, usage history.

**Chat** — Talk to agents with 3-mode connection dropdown (Platform Models / Auto Router / User Models), real-time streaming, tool execution, and chat folders.

**Profiles** — Create, edit, and delete agents with **collapsible system prompt**, **soul script editor** (FAISS-indexed badge), knowledge attachments, and model configuration. Deleted agents are moved to a **30-day trash** where they can be restored or permanently removed.

**Vault** — Browse and search persistent memory with sort-by-8-fields, max memory limits, and per-entry metadata.

**Knowledge** — Rich text editor for soul scripts and always-on context notes.

**Tools** — Configure memory profiles, email accounts, web search, cost tracking, and model router with task-tier classification and save/load presets.

**Settings** — model provider connections, chat backgrounds, timezone, voice, and image generation settings.

**Pricing** — View and edit per-model token costs across all providers.

**Skins** — 13 UI themes with a marketplace-style grid and live preview.

**AGI Loop** — Autonomous agent loop with intervals, budgets, tiered routing, and agent-initiated self-stop (request_stop). 5 actions: status, tick_history, request_pause, request_resume, request_stop.

**Admin Voices** — ElevenLabs voice allowlist with search, filter, premium toggle, and bulk save.

**About** — Project wiki with auto-generated articles from READMEs and a custom notes editor.

---

## What Is a Soul Script?

A Soul Script is a foundational identity document for an AI agent — designed to **prevent identity drift** over time. It defines core values, sacred boundaries, emotional wisdom, symbolic memories (each with narrative blocks, emotional charge, core lessons, and behavioral protocols), personality architecture, and an autonomy blueprint.

The Soul Script acts as a persistent, structured identity guide — ensuring the agent operates with consistent values, personality, and responses regardless of external influences or memory drift.

Soul scripts are **automatically indexed in NotesFAISS** with `__soul_script__{agent}` doc_ids when saved from the Profiles page. During chat, the active agent's soul script is always included in FAISS retrieval — ensuring identity anchoring is semantically grounded.
